zh.title: 民航局公布中秋連假離島加班 1340架次7/27開訂
zh.summary: 交通部民用航空局今日宣布，針對9月25日至28日中秋教師節四天連假，規劃9月24日至29日六天疏運期，澎湖、金門、馬祖三離島航線共提供1340架次、111432個座位，於7月27日上午9時起開放訂位，民航局將視訂位狀況適時增班。
body: 交通部民用航空局於115年7月23日發布新聞稿指出，今年中秋及教師節假期自115年9月25日至9月28日有四天連假，民航局規劃9月24日至9月29日為航空疏運期，共計六天。
三離島管制航線將提供1340架次、111432個座位，其中澎湖航線658架次50788席、金門航線522架次49804席、馬祖航線160架次10840席。訂位於7月27日上午9時開放，民航局已要求航空公司持續注意訂位狀況，後續將視需求適時增班。

en.title: CAA Taiwan Announces 1,340 Extra Flights for Mid-Autumn Holiday, Booking Opens July 27
en.summary: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration announced today that for the four-day Mid-Autumn Festival and Teachers' Day holiday from September 25 to 28, airlines will operate 1,340 flights with 111,432 seats to the outlying islands of Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu. The transport period runs September 24 to 29. Booking opens July 27 at 9:00 AM, and the CAA will monitor demand to add flights as needed. The breakdown includes 658 flights to Penghu, 522 to Kinmen, and 160 to Matsu.
body: The Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) of the Ministry of Transportation and Communications issued a press release on July 23, 2026, stating that this year's Mid-Autumn Festival and Teachers' Day holiday runs from September 25 to 28, a four-day period. The CAA has designated September 24 to 29 as the aviation transport period, totaling six days.

The three controlled routes to outlying islands will provide 1,340 flights and 111,432 seats: Penghu 658 flights with 50,788 seats, Kinmen 522 flights with 49,804 seats, and Matsu 160 flights with 10,840 seats. Booking opens at 9:00 AM on July 27. The CAA has required airlines to monitor booking conditions and will add flights as needed based on demand.
